outline:
Virtual reality (VR) is a fusion of art and technology, widely applied across various fields, including transportation simulators (driver training), BIM-integrated applications (building maintenance training), immersive gaming (next-generation sports, rehabilitation), immersive storytelling (film, animation), factory simulation, museums, and product previews. This course on VR applications focuses on the impact of VR on future technology and daily life, while also exploring the interplay between immersion, imagination, interaction, and human cognitive perception. The course covers the concepts, principles, and implementation methods of VR/AR and interactive haptic technologies, including an introduction to computer vision techniques, to help students understand sensory perception and interaction mechanisms in virtual environments. To enhance practical VR applications, students will be guided in developing innovative and practical multimedia human-computer interaction systems, exploring and evaluating immersive interaction models. Through a combination of theoretical instruction and hands-on practice, this course aims to equip students with core VR/AR technologies, fostering innovation, cross-disciplinary integration, and creative applications, enabling them to contribute to the future development and advancement of immersive technology.

虛擬實境是一種藝術與科技的整合，廣泛運用在不同屬性的領域，如交通模擬器(司機員訓練)、BIM整合應用(建築養護訓練)、沈浸式遊戲(新型態科技運動、復健)、沈浸式敘事(電影、動畫)、工廠模擬、博物館、成品預覽等。本虛擬實境應用之課程內容，將專注於虛擬實境應用對於未來科技、生活等不同層面的影響，同時探討沈浸、想像、互動與人類心理認知的相互關係。課程內容涵蓋VR/AR 及其互動體感技術的概念、原理與實現方法(電腦視覺技術簡介)，幫助學生理解虛擬環境中的感知與互動機制。為強化 VR 技術的實務應用，本課程將帶領學生開發創新且實用的多媒體人機互動系統，探索與評估沉浸式的操作模式。透過理論講解與實作練習，本課程將培養學生掌握 VR/AR 核心技術，並培育其創新應用與跨領域整合能力，使其在未來科技發展中發揮創造力與影響力。
